verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a first-party webhook plugin that delivers error and project data as soon as BugSnag receives and processes it. This lets users subscribe to error events via webhook, and the alerting integrations (Slack, PagerDuty) show event-driven notifications are a core feature. missing for 10: documentation of selectable event types/triggers, payload schema and delivery/signing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook use.
